metadata.title: Angular-Pole Flag Curvature and Conformal Control of Radial Jacobi Fields in Diagonal Conic Finsler Optics
metadata.abstract: We study diagonal conic Finsler optical structures with radial coefficients and an arbitrary angular Finsler norm. We obtain the spray curvature block and identify the angular-pole radial-transverse flag curvature at a critical radius with the negative optical-arclength radial Jacobi coefficient. We prove that a compactly supported radial conformal two-jet determines the critical radius and any signed radial coefficient. A navigation Randers sphere yields unequal oriented periods with a common radial coefficient.
